This takes away tedious manufacturing tasks and stimulates high-throughput production providing researchers with robust datasets to validate their studies. Visit our publication on jove. Three-Dimensional The prototype converges traditional pipetting with advanced biofabrication capabilities to manufacture 3D matrices and execute routine cell culturing workflows simultaneously. High Throughput Fast, automated processing of miniaturized samples in 96 and 384 well plates enables researchers to generate robust datasets.
